<reason>Both sides argued crisply and stayed on the motion's "mainly" framing, but A built the cleaner decisive comparison. A's core causal claim — extra licensed hours are additive rounds on top of pre-loading, so the surge is not merely relocated but enlarged and drunker — survived the exchange. B's own answer to A's Q1 ("I'm not claiming the night gets shorter") handed A that ground, and B's reply was limited to asserting that supervision quality outweighs the extra alcohol, without engaging A's point that hours of pouring change the size and intoxication level of the inevitable dispersal moment. B's strongest strike, the "you conceded my policy with a stopwatch" turn on A's exit-pulse and worker-corridor concessions, was rhetorically excellent but only partially landed: A pre-empted it by distinguishing transit timed to a close (which empties a district) from transit running past the close (which underwrites more pouring), a distinction anchored in the word "mainly." B also repeatedly asserted that A "never named a mechanism" for the 1am crowd going home, when A did name one (last entry, cost/space/risk friction, food and bed) — a mild mischaracterization that weakened B's closing. B did answer A's boundary question honestly and specifically (staggered 2–4am band, last entry earlier), which was good direct pressure-handling, and the Sydney lockout and night-worker fairness lines kept it competitive; A's reply that Sydney was a leaky single precinct requiring broader, not weaker, rules was adequate rather than crushing. Net: a competitive debate where A's mechanism-level weighing was less damaged than B's.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's Q1 forcing B to admit "I'm not claiming the night gets shorter," which A then converted into the deciding frame: the extra hour is the pre-load plus more doubles, so a lit platform is "the crush you built." B's counter-gotcha (A conceding an exit pulse) was neutralized by A's mainly-based distinction between a train that empties a closed district and trains that let venues keep pouring.</best_rebuttal>
